unit: Plan M5a host install and the first M5b gate for cloudflare/security-audit-skill (trial row from PR #448)

steps.detail: Peers native-agent-stack-a9 and token-save-practice-e2e-status were told before the host change; a9 replied it was not mid-edit on the settings file, the skills lock or ~/.agents/skills.

steps.result: only that key added (a Python check compared the whole document with the old one plus the key); permissions.deny length 87 unchanged

steps.evidence_class: our-integration (drives the upstream skills CLI unchanged)

steps.command: append the security-audit block printed by install_skills.py --print-codex-config to ~/.codex/config.toml (after a backup)
TMPDIR=/var/tmp node --test validate-findings.test.cjs validate-coverage-ledger.test.cjs, in a byte-identical copy of the installed folder (sha256 of every file compared)

upstream_identity.method: gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' repos/cloudflare/security-audit-skill/contents/skills/security-audit/<file>?ref=c1c8a8c1471069fb0e188eeaff69b8e8db6564a8 | sha256sum, compared with the installed file

m5b.gate_2_labelled_fixture: open: no upstream labelled set checked yet; no pre-registered seeded copy built
m5b.gate_3_budget: set high by the user on 2026-09-27, but only after Gate A (token-save end to end) and Gate B (settled GPT-6 route); neither has passed (token-save-practice-e2e-status, 2026-09-28)

deviations: The trial decision says the Codex table goes into ~/.codex/config.toml before the install; it was appended 10 s after it (09:08:33Z install, 09:08:43Z append). The Claude override went in first, as planned.
limitations: One host; historical receipts do not certify another host.

Invocation reach is still live-run-pending: whether a typed /security-audit runs, and whether Claude invokes the skill unprompted, were not probed. The skills docs give name-only 'Yes' in the / menu column.
The node tests check the skill's validators only, not audit quality; M5c decides merit.
settings and Codex config backups exist on the host only; their contents are not recorded.
